displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists CMT in the Vision area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “CMT: Convolutional Neural Networks Meet Vision Transformers”. The page names Jianyuan Guo, Yunhe Wang, Chang Xu as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
